_readme: The gate requires every experiments/<id>/ that carries archived *_results.json to have
(a) an entry in storage/memory/knowledge.json and (b) a valid reproduce_spec.json.
An exclusion is an admission that a finding will stay unrecorded or unreproducible.
It is NEVER the cheap way out of writing an artifact. Every entry must state WHY the
artifact cannot exist -- not that writing it was inconvenient. An entry whose reason is
'will do later' is a bug; write the artifact instead.
Directories with NO archived *_results.json are already outside the gate's scope and do
not belong here -- see the module docstring in scripts/check_experiment_artifacts.py.
The 2026-07-19 sweep found 108 such directories (paper-writing sessions, .gitkeep
placeholders, abandoned stubs); listing them here would be noise, not exemption.
